title: Source Explorer
promise: I can open a guided Jewish source without freezing.

title: Canon Navigator
promise: I can identify what kind of Jewish text I am seeing and where it sits in the canon.

title: Text Reader
promise: I can find the case, claim, question, scene, or prayer move in a Jewish text.

title: Learning-Move Apprentice
promise: I can name what a source is doing: asking, answering, proving, interpreting, ruling, or applying.

title: Connected Learner
promise: I can connect one Jewish source to another region of the canon.

title: Independent Beginner
promise: I can continue learning with a visible capability profile and a sustainable rhythm.
